info.name: Ecommerce Backend
info.description: Professional Postman collection for testing and demoing the ecommerce backend endpoints. Requests are grouped by feature package and cover authentication, public catalog browsing, secured admin catalog/inventory/order operations, RBAC management, cart, checkout, and payment flows.
